resources.string: Counts how many short videos you watch.

Reels Counter is a digital-wellbeing tool. It watches for screen changes inside Instagram (and optionally YouTube Shorts) only to notice when you swipe to a new reel, then saves a timestamp and how long you watched. It never saves or sends reel content, usernames, captions, messages, or screenshots, and it makes no network connections. All data stays on this device.
